indicators.indicator: Doha/ Oman talks produce a joint communiqué or framework document
indicators.observability: Reuters, Bloomberg, AP — searchable news event
indicators.notes: Would signal deal framework is finalized; MOU format means no Congressional entanglement.

indicators.indicator: Trump publicly sets a deadline for Iran deal
indicators.observability: Trump Truth Social, press conference, Reuters interview
indicators.notes: Trump's 'no hurry' statement currently weights against near-term deal

indicators.indicator: Strait of Hormuz shipping resumes (tanker crews evacuating)
indicators.notes: NYT reporting backlog of 1,500 ships — actual clearance would be strong deal signal

indicators.indicator: IAEA reports increased inspector access to Iranian nuclear sites
indicators.observability: IAEA quarterly report, Reuters, ISW/CTP Iran Update

indicators.indicator: Trump states 'no hurry' or 'not rushing' into deal (repeat signal)
indicators.observability: Reuters, Bloomberg, direct quote across 3+ language editions
indicators.notes: Repeated 'no hurry' language strengthens H2. Signal already triggered once (May 25).

indicators.indicator: IRGC conducts new military exercise or test in Strait of Hormuz
indicators.observability: IRGC-affiliated media, ISW/CTP, Reuters, Gulf state intelligence
indicators.notes: Escalation signal — IRGC reconstituting capabilities per ISW (B2)

indicators.indicator: Israeli airstrikes on Iranian or IRGC targets in Syria increase
indicators.observability: Syrian state media, Israeli defense sources, SOHR
indicators.notes: Israel operating with maximalist threat tolerance during negotiation window

indicators.indicator: Khamenei publicly endorses or authorizes nuclear negotiations
indicators.observability: IRIB, state media, Reuters, Bloomberg Politics
indicators.notes: Supreme leader endorsement would be strongest single H1 signal. Bloomberg (May 25) framed Khamenei under pressure.
